# Bare Necessities owner-saved fixtures (2026-10-14)

Four collection and ten PDP excerpts from the owner's read-only Chrome Complete saves in `/mnt/nas_data/lingerie_trends/catalog-runs/bare_necessities-pages-20261014/`. `bare-necessities-expected.json` records every source filename and SHA-256, canonical URL, public Shopify identity/vendor/type, page-default variant ID/price and current gallery originals, or listing grid/total/page. No online fetch was used.

Scrubbing retains canonical link, public `window.SwymProductInfo.product` JSON in `#swym-snippet`, public `#elevar-product-view` and the exact Shopify.currency assignment only, plus gallery or `.br-collection` DOM. Other scripts, account/input forms, SVGs, frames, data/event/style attributes and unrelated navigation/recommendations are removed. Public product description JSON remains product evidence. Chrome-local IMG src values are deliberately retained to exercise the saved-page boundary; original URLs come from preserved srcset paths matched against exact product.images entries. No filename guessing or query stripping constructs an original.

Takeover uses canonical-bound Shopify product.type for category evidence; Bras/Panties and explicitly named garter belts in Sexy Lingerie, Accessories are included, with swim/sleep/men/kids exclusions.

All ten products have one canonical `/products/<handle>` across multiple in-page colors/sizes, with Shopify variant URLs `?variant=<id>`. Current gallery has 4–8 images; product.images spans every color and is **not** a download queue. Null selected_color is conservative: neither a color-change save nor a live color transition was supplied. URL identity captures one current-state sample; it does not claim every color was captured. No size clicks or swatch expansion occur.

Price comes from the page's `#elevar-product-view.defaultVariant`, bound by productId, variantId and price to an actual Swym Shopify variant, in currencyCode USD. This is the saved page-default offer, not the product-wide minimum or arbitrary first variant. No availability claim is made, including products with 250 embedded variants that may be Shopify-truncated.

Listing selector `.br-collection .br-product-tile__media-link` yields exactly36 cards per saved page (other search/recommendation cards exist outside this container). Bras pages1/2/3 are distinct; total580. Simone Pérèle page1 total43. `.br-collection__header-results` concatenates number/products without whitespace in textContent. Next is a button without href, disabled at previous page1. Saved `main.min.js.download` proves `searchParams.value.set('page',page)` then pushState and normal collection fetch. Runtime constructs next URL with page=current+1 and requires displayed current equals URL page. Missing grid reports “product grid not rendered — Insider search blocked?” after hydration wait. Result-total reconciliation is the runner's existing positive end gate; synthetic disabled-Next tests establish extraction, not an observed live final page.

Tests: `npm test`; `UV_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/bn-phase2-uv uv run --no-project --python /home/yenchi/.pyenv/versions/3.12.12/bin/python python tests/bare_necessities_browser.py`. All browser requests are fulfilled locally. `PIS_BN_EXPORT=/tmp/...` retains real capture/export output with explicitly synthetic 1×1 PNG image bytes for three smoke fixtures. These artifacts prove serialization/import contracts only.
